Banking

  1. Home
  2. Financial Solutions
  3. Traditional Finance Banking

Your Partner in Traditional Financial Services

The QFC’s banking ecosystem initiates business success by turning possibility into momentum. Under the QFC framework, firms operate in a well-regulated environment to offer a full range of traditional banking activities, from deposit-taking, and credit facilities to investment and treasury services, delivered with the excellence that today's markets demand.
Firms can also serve clients across private banking, corporate and wholesale banking, wealth management, investment banking, and treasury functions. 
At QFC, a business is more than a transaction; every client becomes a financial partner that contributes to Qatar’s expanding financial landscape. 

WHAT WE OFFER 

Explore the Range of Activities we License

Regulated Activities 

  • Deposit-taking  

  • Arranging credit facilities 

  • Private banking 

  • Investment banking and advisory services 

  • Lending and structured finance 

  • Wealth management and portfolio services 

Non-regulated activities

Treasury and Management Offices

  • Intra-group treasury operations

  • Group holding and management office

  • Company headquarters and administrative support functions

Financial Consulting and Advisory(excluding regulated investment advice)

  • Strategic planning, budgeting and feasibility studies

  • Risk management and business restructuring

Credit Rating and Investment Grading

  • Private credit rating services on a contractual basis

  • Ratings may only be published publicly with prior Qatar Financial Centre Authority (QFCA) approval.

Here’s why companies choose to set up a business with QFC:

100% foreign ownership

100% repatriation of profits

Trading in any currency with no restrictions

Competitive 10% corporate tax on locally sourced profits

Legal environment based on Common Law

Access to 80+ double taxation agreements

GET STARTED

Setup Process

Setting up a business at QFC is a transparent, efficient and seamless process. While requirements vary slightly for fintech firms, investment companies and fund managers, the overall journey remains the same, helping you and your business grow with confidence.

Get started with
Qatar Financial Centre

QFC is a leading onshore business and financial centre located in Doha, committed to promoting Qatar as a major business and commercial hub at the crossroads between East and West.

Start Your Setup

Here’s why companies choose to set up a business with QFC:

Regulated activities

Investment managers, insurers, asset managers, fund administrators, and representative offices follow the regulated application route, including submission of a RBP and meeting minimum capital and governance requirements.

Read More

Non-regulated activities

Fintech firms, holding companies, management offices and investment clubs follow a slightly different application track focused on business planning and eligibility. Prudential capital requirements typically do not apply to non-regulated activities
